column1: # EXPLORATORY, NOT THE RUN OF RECORD. Gemma-3-27B-it ALONE, after job 826026 showed the
# pinned co-hosting pair does not start. vLLM's --gpu-memory-utilization is a fraction of
# the WHOLE card measured against what every process on it already holds, not a private
# slice: gemma at 0.65 allocated first, and gpt-oss then computed 0.25 x 141 GiB minus
# gemma's allocation and reported "Available KV cache memory: -39.48 GiB" before dying with
# "No available memory for the cache blocks". The section 6.1 line's 0.65 and 0.25 do not
# add up the way the line assumes, on this card or on the a100-80 it is pinned to.
# So the two are served one at a time. Gemma keeps its pinned 0.65, which on a 141 GB card
# is 92 GB against about 56 GB of bf16 weights.
